title: LIS
definition: Finding the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence in an array. Solved in O(N^2) using standard DP, or O(N log N) using Binary Search + DP.
simpleExplanation: Given a random list of numbers, finding the longest chain of numbers you can pick out that keep going up, without rearranging them.

answers.question: **Expert:** Longest Increasing Subsequence
